notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes: [p]Since 3Paths is going through an endless development cycle, I decided to release the game as early access.[/p][p]Although I tried to do what I could on my own, the game lacks sprites, CGs and music, and I'm out of money, I'm out of time.[/p][p]Since the total number of wishlists hasn't even reached 1000, I don't think it's right to keep anyone waiting any longer.[/p][p]So I'll focus on new updates and try to make the game better looking over time.[/p][p][/p][p]Conceptually most of the game is done but the last minute polishing and extras will take a little more time. I'm planning to release the game in August. If nothing goes wrong at the last minute, I'll release it on August 11th.[/p][p]I'm thinking of selling it for 3.99 dollars (gotta keep those 3s rolling). This will be the price during early access. Of course, this price will drop even more during steam discounts. I will also apply an launch discount.[/p][p]For now the game will only be released on Windows because I don't have the equipment to test MAC and Linux. I will deal with that later.[/p]
